title: Inspect the signal before training
description: Choose one illustrative example, then change temperature and teacher weight. The bars and losses are calculated exactly from the supplied teacher and student logits; they do not predict final model quality.

scenarios.label: Clear teacher decision
scenarios.detail: The teacher and label agree, with dog as the nearest alternative.

scenarios.label: Confusable classes
scenarios.detail: The teacher narrowly prefers fox over dog, exposing a relationship hidden by the hard label.

scenarios.label: Teacher is wrong
scenarios.detail: The ground truth is fox, but the teacher assigns its highest logit to dog.
